problem: The equality check violates the explicit semantic obligation to use one bounded grouped subquery or aggregation: it adds mirrored nested NOT EXISTS UNION branches for missing longitudinal positions instead of expressing the bidirectional pointwise comparison within the required single aggregation-based check.
required_change: Replace the three UNION branches with one bounded grouped-subquery or aggregation-based comparison that detects both vertical mismatches and longitudinal positions present on only one waterline.
regression_guard: Preserve bidirectional pointwise equality between UIWL and the maximum intended-waterline vertical coordinate at every longitudinal position, including missing positions on either side.
